SELECT MAX(inv.id) AS inventoryId, MAX(pi.spu_no) AS spuNo, MAX(pi.category) AS category, MAX(pd.id) AS skuId, MAX(pd.sku_no) AS skuNo, MAX(pd.images_url) AS productImgUrl, MAX(pd."name") AS productName, MAX(inv.warehouse_id) AS warehouseId, MAX(wh."name") AS warehouseName, MAX(COALESCE(wl.code, '')) AS warehouseLocation, MAX(COALESCE(wlt.code, '')) AS warehouseArea, MAX(COALESCE(wlt."name", '')) AS warehouseAreaName, SUM(CASE WHEN inv.dict_inventory_status = 'usable' THEN inv.qty ELSE 0 END) AS usableQty, SUM(CASE WHEN inv.dict_inventory_status = 'frozen' THEN inv.qty ELSE 0 END) AS frozenQty, MAX(inv.org_id) AS orgId, MAX(tf.bill_date) AS latestSalesTime FROM inventory inv LEFT JOIN product_detail pd ON inv.sku_id = pd.id AND pd.is_deleted = false LEFT JOIN product_info pi ON pd.product_id = pi.id AND pi.is_deleted = false AND pi.property NOT IN ('服务', '费用') LEFT JOIN warehouse wh ON inv.warehouse_id = wh.id AND wh.is_deleted = false LEFT JOIN warehouse_location wl ON inv.warehouse_location = wl.code AND wl.is_deleted = false AND wl.warehouse_id = inv.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN warehouse_location wlt ON wl.parent_id = wlt.id AND wlt.is_deleted = false LEFT JOIN (SELECT info_id as inventory_id, MAX(bill_date) AS bill_date FROM inventory_his WHERE is_deleted = false GROUP BY inventory_id) AS tf ON inv.id = tf.inventory_id WHERE inv.is_deleted = false
AND bill_date >= #{params.saleTimeList[0]} and #{params.saleTimeList[1]} + INTERVAL '1 day' > bill_date
AND inv.org_id is not null
and tf.bill_date is not null
AND inv.warehouse_id IN
#{item}
AND pi.spu_no IN
#{item}
AND pi.category_id IN
#{item}
AND pd.sku_no IN
#{item}
AND (pd.name ILIKE concat('%', #{params.skuStr}::text ,'%') or pd.sku_no ILIKE concat('%', #{params.skuStr}::text ,'%'))
GROUP BY inv.id
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN inv.dict_inventory_status = 'usable' THEN inv.qty ELSE 0 END) > 0 OR SUM(CASE WHEN inv.dict_inventory_status = 'frozen' THEN inv.qty ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY skuNo ASC, warehouseName ASC, inventoryId ASC

select wh.id, wh.create_user_name AS createUserName, wh.create_time AS createTime, wh.name, wh.type_id AS typeId , wh.charge_id AS chargeId, wh.contacts, wh.contact_tel_number AS contactTelNumber, wh.disabled, wh.address, wh.warehouse_manage_type AS warehouseManageType, wh.geography_location AS geographyLocation, wh.org_id AS orgId, wh.kingdee_warehouse_code AS kingdeeWarehouseCode, wh.is_virtual AS isVirtual, wh.approve_status AS approveStatus, wh.is_enable_location as isEnableLocation from warehouse wh where wh.is_deleted = false
and ((wh.kingdee_warehouse_code = #{params.searchKeyword}) or wh.name ilike concat('%', #{params.searchKeyword}::text ,'%'))
and wh.approve_status = #{params.approveStatus}
and wh.disabled = #{params.disabled}
order by
case when wh.name ILIKE concat(#{params.searchKeyword}::text,'%') THEN 1 when wh.name ILIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword}::text) THEN 2 when wh.name ILIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword}::text,'%') THEN 3 end , wh.name,
wh.kingdee_warehouse_code asc
